intro: Your table, your rules. From coffee chats to dinner dates, our Milee convertible table adapts to all your occasions in its compact style.

features.title: Glossy, scratch-safe top
features.text: With its high gloss, scratch-resistant finish, your table stays stunning and smooth through everyday use.

features.title: From table to dining
features.text: The lift-up top transforms into a dining surface for four—great for small spaces and big appetites.

features.title: Small space savior
features.text: Designed for flexibility, this compact piece turns any room into a living, working, or dining zone.

features.title: Hidden storage space
features.text: Keep it clutter-free with in-built storage compartments that tuck away neatly beneath the surface.

features.title: Dual-side access
features.text: Easily reach stored items from either side—because convenience should never be one-sided.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Milee Engineered Wood Convertible Coffee Table With Lift Up Dining Top
